encounter: P12 play_order 144, E0170 TRAINER_JODY (Petalburg Gym room 7 - Aerilate offense), cap 42
availability_audit: Petalburg Gym is challenged in C27; cap 42 until Norman's badge at the end of the Gym. No Surf. Every member is in work/reference-pools/pool-42.json with gate <= 42 and a source map walked by C26. Aggronite stone-window 42 and Aggron base-window 42, both cleared; Mega Ring from Steven in C13. Route 118 and New Mauville sources excluded. No legendary, mythical, Ultra Beast or Paradox species.
plan: Jody's crack list is Rock and Electric against the converted Flying damage, Steel to wall it, and a Ghost to blank Tauros and Bouffalant. Steel is the backbone here because it does three jobs at once against this room: it resists Normal, Flying and Rock, which between them are most of what Jody's six throw. Mega Aggron is the Mega for that reason - Filter on top of base 230 Defense, with Body Press turning that Defense into 2x damage against six Normal-typed bodies, and Rock Slide held specifically because Rock is 4x into Mega Pinsir's Bug/Flying. Aegislash adds a second Steel that is also immune to Normal and Fighting outright - and critically, unlike Berke's and Mary's rooms, Jody's six contain no Scrappy, so that immunity actually holds. Weavile's Ice Shard is the priority answer to Aerilate Quick Attack: Ice is 2x into Mega Pinsir, Sawsbuck and Diggersby. Fire from Incineroar and Chandelure is 2x into Mega Pinsir and Sawsbuck. Togekiss is immune to High Horsepower, which three separate members carry. Declared in advance: base Moxie and post-Mega Aerilate do not coexist, so Pinsir should not be chaining Moxie boosts through the transition, and Sawsbuck's Sap Sipper means no Grass move is on this party.
